run_flask_mos_server: run a Flask app for Mean Opinion Score surveys using flask run or gunicorn on port 4567
create_survey_study: create a new MOS survey study by submitting XP or grid names via the index route
run_survey_rating: run a survey page to rate audio model samples on a 1 to 5 scale with blind mode support
view_survey_results: view aggregated MOS results with mean ratings and confidence intervals for a survey signature
login_user_session: login a user to the MOS survey app via the login route and store session data
